text: Computer Science and Technology program began enrollment in 1999.Through years of construction and development, it isbecomingone of the majorswith themost solid educational foundationand achievement. This programwaslisted as the provincialkey constructionspecialty in 2007, as the provincialnew characteristicspecialtyin 2014, and as the provincialcharacteristicspecialty in 2017.The discipline of Computer ScienceandTechnology is theprovincial keydisciplineand theprovincialfirst-class discipline(ClassB),which owns theKey Laboratory of Forestry Intelligent Monitoring and Information Technologyof Zhejiang Province. In the past years, the program has adopted various strategies to educate featured talents and to promote students' practical capability and cultivating innovation and entrepreneurship by means of academic competitions.According to MyCOS survey, graduates of this major have ranked the top in terms of satisfaction, employment salary and employment competitiveness in recent years.Featured in the combination of information technology and agriculture forestry, the professional education of the program is unique. First, the program takes advantage of the forestry industry to carry out specialty training. The program also established two specialties, which are in agriculture forestry information technology and embedded IOT systems, respectively, to improve the training system. Second, the program developed featured courses and jointly founded the outstanding engineers innovative experimental class with Tarena Education Group. Third, the program developed diversified practice bases to promote the integration of government, industry, academia and research. Accordingly, multiple on-campus platforms for innovation and entrepreneurship were established; a number of stable off-campus training bases were formed under cooperation with well-known IT enterprises. The introduction of certification exammechanism directly connects the program to the job market. The program cultivates innovation and entrepreneurship by means of academic competitions. Taking advantage of the school's innovative platforms, the program highly encourages students to participate in academic competitions.Graduates of the program willhave the ability to adapt to the development of society, economy and information technology industry,alsohave good humanistic qualities, moral quality and communication skills, and have strong engineering practicecapability, innovationspiritand competitiveness.The program expects the graduates achieve the following goals in5years after graduation:1. An ability of using the professional knowledge and technology to design computer software and hardware systems, especially solutions for embedded and agriculture and forestryinformatizationrelated systems, and an ability to successfully implement the designed solutions;2. An ability to become a core member or a leader of a team, and to effectively make contributions;3.Strong project management and communication skills, good professional cultivation and moral standards, professional competitiveness in related fields;4.An ability to improve his/her knowledge and capability through further education or lifelong learning;5.Familiar with the politics, economy and culture of contemporary China, able to participate in and promote the friendly exchanges and cooperation between China and their host countries.
